# 1. Libraries

Required packages (install if missing):
`install.packages(c("igraph", "ggraph", "tidygraph", "ggforce", "RColorBrewer", "scales"))`

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(igraph)
library(ggraph)
library(tidygraph)
library(ggforce)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(scales)
```

# 2. Parameters

```{r params}
wd_mirna <- "F:/wd/cohort7_miRNAs/cohort7_miRNAs"

tissues <- c("hypo", "liver", "panc", "gut", "ewat", "iwat", "bat", "gas", "sol")

# Minimum Jaccard index to draw an edge between two pathways
JACCARD_THRESHOLD <- 0.1

# Maximum pathways per tissue (top by p.adjust) to keep the network readable
MAX_PATHWAYS <- 150

# Number of top nodes per module to annotate with pathway labels
LABEL_TOP_N <- 3

date_str   <- format(Sys.Date(), "%Y-%m-%d")
dir_output <- file.path(wd_mirna, "output", "04.3_pathway_network", date_str)
dir.create(dir_output, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
cat("Output directory:", dir_output, "\n")

# Database color palette
source_colors <- c(
  "GO BP"                  = "#4DAF4A",
  "KEGG"                   = "#E41A1C",
  "Reactome"               = "#984EA3",
  "MSigDB:Hallmark"        = "#FF7F00",
  "MSigDB:C2_KEGG"         = "#A65628",
  "MSigDB:C2_Reactome"     = "#F781BF",
  "MSigDB:C2_WikiPathways" = "#999999"
)
```

# 3. Load pathway results from 04_GO_KEGG output

```{r find_input}
find_latest_dated_dir <- function(base) {
  dirs  <- list.dirs(base, full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE)
  dated <- sort(
    dirs[grepl("^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$", basename(dirs))],
    decreasing = TRUE
  )
  if (length(dated) == 0) stop("No dated subdirectory found under: ", base)
  cat("Using pathway results from:", dated[1], "\n")
  dated[1]
}

base_04   <- file.path(wd_mirna, "output", "04_GO_KEGG")
input_dir <- find_latest_dated_dir(base_04)
```

```{r load_csv}
safe_read <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    cat("File not found — skipped:", basename(path), "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  df <- read.csv(path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  cat("Loaded", nrow(df), "rows from:", basename(path), "\n")
  df
}

go_bp_all    <- safe_read(file.path(input_dir, "GO",       "GO_BP_tissue_cluster_all.csv"))
kegg_all     <- safe_read(file.path(input_dir, "KEGG",     "KEGG_tissue_cluster_all.csv"))
msigdb_all   <- safe_read(file.path(input_dir, "MSigDB",   "MSigDB_tissue_cluster_all.csv"))
reactome_all <- safe_read(file.path(input_dir, "Reactome", "Reactome_tissue_cluster_all.csv"))
```

```{r combine_databases}
# Standardise to: tissue, miRNA_cluster, ID, Description, p.adjust, geneID, source
add_source <- function(df, src) {
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)
  df %>%
    dplyr::select(tissue, miRNA_cluster, ID, Description, p.adjust, geneID) %>%
    mutate(source        = src,
           miRNA_cluster = as.character(miRNA_cluster))
}

msigdb_rows <- if (!is.null(msigdb_all) && nrow(msigdb_all) > 0) {
  bind_rows(lapply(unique(msigdb_all$msigdb_set), function(s) {
    add_source(
      msigdb_all %>%
        filter(msigdb_set == s) %>%
        dplyr::select(tissue, miRNA_cluster, ID, Description, p.adjust, geneID),
      paste0("MSigDB:", s)
    )
  }))
} else NULL

all_pathways <- bind_rows(
  add_source(go_bp_all,    "GO BP"),
  add_source(kegg_all,     "KEGG"),
  add_source(reactome_all, "Reactome"),
  msigdb_rows
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(geneID), geneID != "")

cat("\nTotal pathway entries:", nrow(all_pathways), "\n")
cat("Tissues:", paste(sort(unique(all_pathways$tissue)), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Sources:", paste(sort(unique(all_pathways$source)), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

# 4. Jaccard index functions

```{r jaccard_functions}
# Parse "/" separated gene symbols from geneID column
parse_gene_set <- function(gene_str) {
  if (is.na(gene_str) || gene_str == "") return(character(0))
  unique(trimws(unlist(strsplit(as.character(gene_str), "/"))))
}

# Jaccard similarity: |A ∩ B| / |A ∪ B|
jaccard_index <- function(a, b) {
  if (length(a) == 0 || length(b) == 0) return(0)
  length(intersect(a, b)) / length(union(a, b))
}

# Compute all pairwise Jaccard edges above threshold
# Returns tibble: from, to, jaccard
compute_jaccard_edges <- function(node_ids, gene_lists, threshold) {
  n     <- length(node_ids)
  edges <- vector("list", n * (n - 1L) / 2L)
  k     <- 0L
  for (i in seq_len(n - 1L)) {
    for (j in (i + 1L):n) {
      jv <- jaccard_index(gene_lists[[i]], gene_lists[[j]])
      if (jv >= threshold) {
        k         <- k + 1L
        edges[[k]] <- list(from = node_ids[i], to = node_ids[j], jaccard = jv)
      }
    }
  }
  if (k == 0L) return(tibble(from = character(), to = character(), jaccard = numeric()))
  bind_rows(edges[seq_len(k)])
}
```

# 5. Network construction, Louvain module detection, and visualization per tissue

```{r network_per_tissue, results="asis", fig.height=12, fig.width=14}
all_module_tables <- list()

for (tis in tissues) {
  cat("\n\n##", tis, "\n\n")

  # One node per unique (source, ID): keep entry with smallest p.adjust
  tis_df <- all_pathways %>%
    filter(tissue == tis) %>%
    group_by(source, ID) %>%
    slice_min(p.adjust, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup()

  if (nrow(tis_df) < 2) {
    cat("Too few pathways (", nrow(tis_df), ") — skipped.\n\n")
    next
  }

  if (nrow(tis_df) > MAX_PATHWAYS) {
    tis_df <- tis_df %>% slice_min(p.adjust, n = MAX_PATHWAYS, with_ties = FALSE)
    cat("Trimmed to top", MAX_PATHWAYS, "pathways by p.adjust.\n")
  }

  tis_df <- tis_df %>%
    mutate(
      node_id   = paste0(source, "|", ID),
      neg_log_p = pmin(-log10(pmax(p.adjust, 1e-10)), 10)
    )

  gene_lists <- lapply(tis_df$geneID, parse_gene_set)
  edges      <- compute_jaccard_edges(tis_df$node_id, gene_lists, JACCARD_THRESHOLD)

  cat("Pathways:", nrow(tis_df),
      "| Edges (J >=", JACCARD_THRESHOLD, "):", nrow(edges), "\n")

  if (nrow(edges) == 0) {
    cat("No edges above threshold — network plot skipped.\n\n")
    next
  }

  # Build igraph object
  verts <- tis_df %>%
    dplyr::select(name = node_id, Description, source, p.adjust,
                  neg_log_p, miRNA_cluster)

  g <- graph_from_data_frame(edges, directed = FALSE, vertices = verts)

  # Louvain community detection weighted by Jaccard index
  set.seed(42)
  comm        <- cluster_louvain(g, weights = E(g)$jaccard)
  V(g)$module <- as.character(membership(comm))
  n_mods      <- max(membership(comm))
  cat("Louvain modules:", n_mods, "\n")

  # Store module membership
  mod_tbl <- tibble(
    tissue      = tis,
    node_id     = V(g)$name,
    Description = V(g)$Description,
    source      = V(g)$source,
    p.adjust    = V(g)$p.adjust,
    module      = V(g)$module
  )
  all_module_tables[[tis]] <- mod_tbl

  write.csv(
    edges %>% mutate(tissue = tis),
    file.path(dir_output, paste0("jaccard_edges_", tis, ".csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  write.csv(
    mod_tbl,
    file.path(dir_output, paste0("module_membership_", tis, ".csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  # ── Layout & plot ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  tg <- as_tbl_graph(g)
  lo <- create_layout(tg, layout = "stress")

  # Module color palette (interpolated from Set3)
  base_cols <- brewer.pal(min(max(n_mods, 3), 12), "Set3")
  mod_pal   <- setNames(
    colorRampPalette(base_cols)(n_mods),
    sort(unique(V(g)$module))
  )

  src_pal <- source_colors[intersect(names(source_colors), unique(lo$source))]

  # Nodes to label: top LABEL_TOP_N per module by significance
  label_ids <- lo %>%
    group_by(module) %>%
    slice_max(neg_log_p, n = LABEL_TOP_N, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    pull(name)

  # Nodes in modules with ≥3 members (needed for convex hull drawing)
  lo_hull <- lo %>%
    group_by(module) %>%
    filter(n() >= 3) %>%
    ungroup()

  p <- ggraph(lo) +
    # Module background: convex hulls colored per community
    {
      if (nrow(lo_hull) > 0)
        geom_mark_hull(
          data    = lo_hull,
          aes(x = x, y = y, fill = module, group = module),
          alpha   = 0.14,
          color   = NA,
          expand  = unit(6, "mm"),
          radius  = unit(5, "mm"),
          show.legend = FALSE
        )
      else
        geom_blank()
    } +
    scale_fill_manual(values = mod_pal) +
    # Edges: width encodes Jaccard index
    geom_edge_link(
      aes(edge_width = jaccard),
      color = "grey50",
      alpha = 0.55
    ) +
    scale_edge_width(range = c(0.3, 3.5), name = "Jaccard index") +
    # Nodes: color = database source, size = -log10(p.adjust)
    geom_node_point(
      aes(color = source, size = neg_log_p),
      alpha = 0.90
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = src_pal, name = "Database") +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(3, 10), name = "-log10(p.adjust)") +
    # Labels for top nodes per module
    geom_node_text(
      aes(
        label  = str_trunc(Description, 35),
        filter = name %in% label_ids
      ),
      size         = 2.7,
      color        = "grey15",
      repel        = TRUE,
      max.overlaps = 20
    ) +
    labs(
      title    = paste0("Pathway similarity network — ", tis),
      subtitle = paste0(
        nrow(tis_df), " pathways | ",
        nrow(edges),  " edges (J ≥ ", JACCARD_THRESHOLD, ") | ",
        n_mods,        " modules (Louvain)"
      )
    ) +
    theme_void(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 14),
      plot.subtitle   = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 9, color = "grey40"),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.box      = "vertical"
    )

  print(p)

  ggsave(
    file.path(dir_output, paste0("pathway_network_", tis, ".svg")),
    p, width = 14, height = 12
  )
  cat("Saved: pathway_network_", tis, ".svg\n\n", sep = "")
}
```

# 6. Module summary across all tissues

```{r module_summary}
if (length(all_module_tables) > 0) {
  all_modules_df <- bind_rows(all_module_tables)

  write.csv(
    all_modules_df,
    file.path(dir_output, "pathway_modules_all_tissues.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  cat("Saved: pathway_modules_all_tissues.csv (", nrow(all_modules_df), "rows)\n\n")

  cat("=== Module counts per tissue ===\n")
  all_modules_df %>%
    group_by(tissue) %>%
    summarise(
      n_modules  = n_distinct(module),
      n_pathways = n(),
      .groups    = "drop"
    ) %>%
    print()

  cat("\n=== Representative pathways per module (top 3 by p.adjust) ===\n")
  all_modules_df %>%
    group_by(tissue, module) %>%
    slice_min(p.adjust, n = 3, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(tissue, as.integer(module), p.adjust) %>%
    dplyr::select(tissue, module, source, Description, p.adjust) %>%
    print(n = Inf)
} else {
  cat("No module results — all tissues were skipped.\n")
}
```
